items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 43:1
items.html: Before the sin, the First Man had NRN from the BYA that were in Atzilut. And because of the sin they were lost from him, and there remained in him only the discernment of the souls [Nefashot] in the vessels of the crowns of each and every Sefira in the Partzufim of BYA — except for the first two Partzufim, the AVI of Beriah, of which he had nothing. And there are here three discernments: first, the nine upper [Sefirot] of the lights, which departed from him to their root, for in lights there is no falling to the Klipot, God forbid. Second, the nine lower [Sefirot] of the vessels, with their sparks, which fell to the Klipot and were immersed in them. Third, the light of the soul [Nefesh] in the vessels of the crowns that remained in him. And the reason that the light of the Nefesh clothes in the vessel of the crown is by reason of the inverse value between vessels and lights, as is known. And these three discernments apply in each and every Sefira of the Partzufim of BYA, for there remained in him from each Sefira in them only the discernment of a Nefesh alone, in the vessel of the crown; the nine upper [Sefirot] of each Sefira departed to their root, and the nine lower [Sefirot] of the vessels in each Sefira, with the sparks in them, fell into the depths of the Klipot. (Item 125).
